title: Invertibility and unit equation of the derived quotient adjunct
statement: With the coefficient data and prescribed quotient arrows of [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-coordinates, def-coef-compact-support-reduction-maps], for any scheme X and arbitrary unbounded completed-coefficient derived object K, the transpose beta of rho_mn under the normalized quotient derived scalar adjunction is invertible and rho_mn=eta_q;Res_q(beta). No chain-model, input-coherence or geometric compact-support assertion is included.

proof.text: Apply the twice-transposed-unit calculation to the two integral scalar adjunctions and the quotient adjunction with compactSupportRestrictionComp. The adjunct is the canonical left-adjoint composition isomorphism. The Hom equivalence applied to its inverse image gives the unit equation.

theorem compactSupportQuotient_adjunct
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)) :
    (∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      IsIso ((((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E X m n h)).homEquiv
        _ _).symm (compactSupportReductionMap l E X m n h K))) ∧
      compactSupportReductionMap l E X m n h K =
        (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E X m n h)).unit.app
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E X m).obj K) ≫
          (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars X
            (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction
        (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E X m n h)).homEquiv
        _ _).symm (compactSupportReductionMap l E X m n h K))))
